title: Positioning oral health into the global environmental and public health agendas
html: The health care sector contributes substantially to global greenhouse gas emissions and environmental pollution, and oral health is an integral part of this footprint. Consequently, oral health is increasingly recognized as being closely connected to environmental sustainability, climate resilience, planetary health, and sustainable development. The World Health Organization (WHO) reaffirms its commitment to positioning oral health within global environmental and public health agendas to advance prevention-oriented, equitable, and resilient health systems.
